description: Total the cost of a recipe's ingredients and work out the cost per serving and per 10 servings. Use when budgeting a dish, pricing meal prep or comparing recipes on cost. Do NOT use to resize the recipe (use scale_recipe first, then price the scaled amounts here).

currency.description: Currency code for display only, e.g. 'EUR'; default USD

cost.description: Cost of the amount used in the recipe, 0 or more, in the given currency

servings.description: How many servings the recipe makes, positive, e.g. 4

name: cost_per_serving

currency.description: Currency code used in the results (upper case)

per_serving.description: Cost per serving, rounded to cents

per_ten_servings.description: Cost for 10 servings, rounded to cents

title: Cost per serving
